date.description: Today in the report zone, YYYY-MM-DD.

previous.description: The same number of days just before it.

weekAgo.description: The same days a week back (Today: the same weekday last week; 7 days: the week before).

lowSample.description: `current` is under 20: its change is noise, so the Overview says "few so far".

now.description: The server's now, in the report zone.

cut.description: HH:MM in the report zone: every window ends at this clock time.

dayShare.description: A usual day's share of site visits in by now, 0 to 1.

early.description: Today, under 15% of a usual day in: most numbers are too small yet.

scaledDays.description: This month past last month's length: last month whole, scaled to this many days.

hourlySince.description: When hourly counting began; a cut day before it is estimated.

countingSince.description: The first day of any count.

since.description: The first day its kinds were counted.

expected.description: What this period would be if nothing had changed: the window cut at the same clock time (a usual row: their mean).

base.description: The raw count the expected number was made from (yesterday's whole day when estimated; the four windows' sum for a usual row).

k.description: Scales the base to the expected number: 1, 1/4 for a mean of four, the day's usual share for an estimate.

estimated.description: A cut day had no hourly counts: its part is its day total times a usual day's share by then (say "about").

change.description: How the change is said: a count (+3) under 20 expected, a whole percentage from 20, or so many times as many above +200%. Null for tooFew, none, new and noHistory.

available.description: A usual row only: how many of its windows have counts (0 to 4; a verdict needs 2).

low.description: A usual row only: the low end of where the number usually lands by now.

comparesFrom.description: noHistory only: the date (YYYY-MM-DD) this comparison starts.

slots.description: HH:MM for hours, YYYY-MM-DD for days (the month: every day of it), the Monday of each week.

now.description: The count per slot, the current slot so far, null after it.

previous.description: The comparison's count per slot (yesterday, the same day 7 or 28 days before, last month's same day, the week 12 before); null where it has no such slot.

previousTotal.description: The comparison's whole total (yesterday, the period before, last month).

usual.description: Hours only: the usual same weekdays' running totals (null under 2 with counts).

hidden.description: Why there's no projection: before a quarter of a usual day (or week, or 3 days of the month) is in, under 15 so far (30 for the month), or no shape yet.

showsFrom.description: early only: when it will show. HH:MM (a day), YYYY-MM-DD (the month), weekday-part ("tuesday-afternoon", the week).

share.description: The usual share done by now that the projection divides by.

value.description: The projected total (today, the month or this week). An estimate: drawn dashed, labelled Projected, never a verdict.

slot.description: The current slot's projected total (today's column, this week's).

path.description: Hours only: projected running totals from the now slot to midnight.

rate.description: The month only: the projected daily rate.

periodTotal.description: The period's projected total (whole slots plus the current one's projection).
